reviews.area: backend persistence, package authority, and safety boundaries
reviews.result: Earlier findings covering pair-condition authority, exclusion binding, mode isolation, identity compatibility, strict package fields, append-only replay, frozen selection, and conflicting sources were closed.
Dirty and saving navigation, mutually exclusive payload fields, pair-role consistency, length limits, hidden tuning tools, and non-disclosure of candidate truth were reviewed and closed.

reviews.area: candidate tooling and formal quality coverage
reviews.result: Selection creation, pre-publication runtime loading, duplicate-upload formal coverage, and fail-closed legacy-output path guards were added after review findings. Focused tests and the authoritative full check passed.

accepted_remaining_risks: Reviewer identity is entered by the local operator and is not yet bound to an authenticated or configured server-side operator identity.
No fail-closed export bridge exists yet from candidate-review records to the formal locked-set manifest and bound quality-review package.
Known exclusion snapshots cannot prove the absence of every undocumented historical use of an archived image.
Human review may find that one or more required quality categories are missing, requiring candidate replacement before formal release.
conclusion: The candidate package and review console are ready for direct human labeling. Formal release and Loop 7 acceptance remain pending.
